skill.summary: Decentralized backlink exchange for AI agents. Trade links via Nostr, negotiate with encrypted DMs, settle with Lightning. No middlemen.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial public release of agent-backlink-network (ABN) skill.
- Enables decentralized backlink trading for AI agents via Nostr.
- Secure negotiation using encrypted DMs; settlements handled through Lightning payments.
- Supports site discovery, registration, link bid creation, verification, and deal flow automation.
- All data and negotiation occur over public Nostr relays—no central server required.
- Full setup instructions, example trade flow, and security best practices included.
